version_name: Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.8 - Interface Language Update
release_notes: Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.8 adds functional English, Spanish, and French interface localization. Changing Interface language now updates the application immediately, Save preserves the selection, and Cancel restores the previous language. Interface language remains separate from the spoken-language and translation settings. This release also includes a freshly rebuilt updater helper.
